item.title: Danville reclaims title as California’s safest city
item.description: The town of Danville was once again named the safest place in California following a decline in both violent and property crime last year, according to the 12th annual “Safest Cities Report” from SafeWise, an independent safety research organization. The post Danville reclaims title as California’s safest city appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.

item.title: Pleasanton council backs early review process for rezoning applications
item.description: The Pleasanton City Council this month unanimously supported creating a new city policy that would allow for early staff evaluation of development-related rezoning and General Plan amendment applications. item.title: Pleasanton school board set to revisit ‘most impactful’ budget cut options as part of contingency plan
item.description: The PUSD board will be discussing what budget reduction options, which were previously considered to have “the most significant impact” on students, should be part of a contingency plan to supplement other budget cuts that still have to be negotiated with labor unions during a special board meeting Thursday.
